q1.a: Creating and previewing are free. You pay when you publish, at the price of the design you chose.

q2.q: How do I send it to guests?
q2.a: Once published, your invitation gets its own link. Send it on Telegram, WhatsApp or by SMS — guests don't need to install anything.

q3.q: Can I edit it after publishing?
q3.a: Yes. Change the time, venue or photos any time; the link stays the same. Only the design can’t change after payment.

q4.q: How long does the invitation stay online?
q4.a: It stays online after the event too. A year after the event its photos are deleted; the text is kept.

q5.q: What happens to an unfinished draft?
q5.a: Drafts not edited for 7 days automatically lose their photos; the draft itself is kept. You can keep up to 30 drafts at a time.
